final_submission.explanation: Hagen-Poiseuille law matches the given reference point exactly (10 kPa, 0.5 mm, 20 cm, 1 mPa·s -> 1.2271846 mL/s) within stated laminar regime. Units: dP in kPa=1000 Pa, r in mm=1e-3 m, L in cm=1e-2 m, mu in mPa·s=1e-3 Pa·s. Q [m^3/s] = pi*(dP*1000)*(r*1e-3)^4/(8*(mu*1e-3)*(L*1e-2)) = pi*dP*r^4/(8*mu*L) * (1000*1e-12)/(1e-3*1e-2) = pi*dP*r^4/(8*mu*L) * 1e-4. Convert to mL/s: multiply by 1e6 -> factor 100. So Q_mL/s = 100*pi*dP*r^4/(8*mu*L) = 12.5*pi*dP*r^4/(mu*L). Check: 12.5*pi*10*0.0625/(1*20)=12.5*pi*0.625/20=12.5*pi*0.03125=0.390625*pi=1.2271846. ✓
